name: Electrodominance
oracle_text: Electrodominance deals X damage to any target. You may cast a spell with mana value X or less from your hand without paying its mana cost.
blocked_sentences: You may cast a spell with mana value X or less from your hand without paying its mana cost.

needs.what: an effect op that, on resolution, lets its controller choose one card in their own hand matching a selector and cast it immediately without paying its mana cost -- the real card leaving the hand for the stack, not a copy. It needs (a) an `objects`/`selector` slot so the choice can be narrowed by `mana_value` compared against the spell's `x` (Electrodominance: mana value X or less), by type, or by name; (b) optionality, so declining is legal and the spell still resolves; (c) the cast to happen during this spell's resolution, ignoring timing restrictions, the way a `cast_free` cast does; (d) X and other cost choices on the freely cast spell to be settable to 0 as normal for a no-mana-cost cast. Reuse of whatever machinery `look_at_top`'s `cast_free` already invokes, retargeted at the hand zone, is the obvious shape.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `look_at_top` is the only op in `op_options` carrying `cast_free`, and its whole spec is anchored to the top of the library (`amount`, `rest_to_bottom`, `destination`) -- there is no key to point it at the hand, and looking at the top N cards is a different, visible, public action from choosing out of your own hand. `play_exiled` (`as`, `objects`) plays a card the effect exiled: it is a *zone* permission for exile, it does not waive the mana cost, and Electrodominance never exiles anything. `grant_playable` (`any_type`, `limit`, `objects`) is likewise only a permission to play a card from somewhere other than hand at its printed cost and printed timing -- it grants no free cast, and a card in hand is already playable, so it is a no-op here. `cast_copy` and `copy_spell` cast or copy a *copy* of a spell; Electrodominance's spell has to leave hand and go on the stack as itself, so a copy is a different card in a different zone with different aftermath (the original stays in hand). `may` (`pay`, `effects`) supplies only the optionality, with no child op that can perform the cast. `cascade` casts free but only off the top of the library, at a mana value strictly less than this spell's, with the rest exiled -- wrong zone and wrong selection. Nothing in `static_effects` helps: `cast_from_graveyard` and `cast_from_library_top` are zone permissions at full cost. The damage half is plain `damage` with `{"x": true}` at an `any`-kind target and is not blocked, but the second sentence has no expressible form, so no partial answer was written.
